seoTitle: Utica Community Schools Calendar 2027–28: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Utica Community Schools starts Aug. 30, 2027, and ends June 13, 2028. See breaks, half days, exams, the new grade configuration, official PDF, and ICS download.
schemaDatasetDescription: Districtwide 2027–28 calendar dates for Utica Community Schools, including the first and last day, breaks, holidays, no-school days, half days, conferences, exams, and marking-period endings.
heroSummary: Utica Community Schools starts Monday, August 30, 2027. Elementary students have a half day on the first day; the district overview does not list a half day for secondary students. The last day is Tuesday, June 13, 2028, with a half day for all K-12 students. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24–26, Winter Break December 20–31, Mid-Winter Break February 21–25, and Spring Break March 27–31. Good Friday is a separate no-school day on April 14.

customSections.label: The First Year of UCS’s New Grade Configuration
customSections.content: The 2027–28 school year is the first year of UCS’s districtwide configuration of K-5 elementary schools, 6–8 middle schools, and 9–12 high schools. The district calendar still uses “Junior High” for the October 12 conference entry. This page keeps that terminology while explaining UCS’s new middle-school grade structure.

customSections.label: How to Read the UCS Calendar
customSections.content: Not every UCS half day or conference date applies to every student. The district uses separate elementary, secondary, and all-student schedules, so families should check the grade-level label on each date.

groups.label: Conference dates affect different student groups
items: October 7 is a secondary half day for conferences, while October 19 is an elementary half day for conferences.
October 12 is an evening conference date. The overview does not label it as a half day or no-school date.

groups.label: Secondary Exam Half Days
items: Secondary students have exam half days on January 12–13 and June 9.
January 14 is a half day for all students and still includes secondary exams. June 12–13 are all-student half days, but the district overview does not label them as exam days.

groups.label: Teacher DPPD No-School Days
items: UCS lists four Teacher Full Day DPPD dates when K-12 students do not attend: September 15, October 20, November 2, and January 26.

groups.label: The March 8 reason is not stated
items: The district overview lists March 8 as an elementary half day without giving a reason, so this page does not assign one.

customSections.label: Current Published Half-Day Times
customSections.content: UCS currently publishes these hours for 2025–26. Because grade configurations change in fall 2027, do not assume these dismissal times will apply in 2027–28. Check the district or school page before making pickup plans.

calendarFaqs.q: What grade levels are elementary, middle school, and high school in UCS in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The 2027–28 school year is the first year of UCS’s districtwide configuration of K-5 elementary schools, 6–8 middle schools, and 9–12 high schools.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does the 2027–28 calendar still say “Junior High” after UCS changes to a 6–8 middle-school configuration?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar retains the term “Junior High” for the October 12 evening conference entry. UCS’s separate grade-configuration guidance says the district moves to a 6–8 middle-school configuration in fall 2027, so this page preserves the official event name while explaining the new grade structure.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students have school on the October 12 evening conference date?
calendarFaqs.a: The district overview does not mark October 12 as a half day or no-school day. It lists Junior High evening conferences only. Families should check the school notice for any later schedule change.

calendarFaqs.q: What does “Teacher Full Day DPPD” mean on the UCS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: On the UCS calendar, these are no-school days for K-12 students while teachers report for a full DPPD day. The overview does not spell out the acronym.
